prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The person's right hand is hovering at a distance from the scanner with a visible gap; no touching or grasping is visible.
The person's right hand is near the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear physical touching.
The person's right hand is approaching but visibly separated from the scanner/base with a clear gap.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear touching or grasping.
Right hand is close and reaching toward the scanner, but a visible gap remains with no clear touch or grasp.
Right hand is reaching near the scanner, but a visible gap remains and no clear touching or grasping is shown.
The right hand is close to the pink scanner but a visible gap remains; no clear touching or grasping is visible.
The person's right hand is visibly wrapped around and touching the pink scanner/object.
Right hand is very close to the scanner but no clear visible touch or grasp; contact is ambiguous.
Right hand is close to the scanner, but visible physical touching or grasping is not clearly established.
The person's right hand is visibly wrapped against/occluding the side of the pink scanner, indicating contact.
